14SCG NICHIREI LOGISTICS : Navanakorn Cold Storage
SCG Nichirei Logistics (SCGN) expanded its Navanakorn cold storage 
logistics center in Pathum Thani, increasing capacity for temperature -
controlled storage to 16,310 pallets (35,100 tons).
The joint venture, with registered capital of THB 28 million, is jointly held by 
SCGJWD (40%), RUIYUN (49%), and GOLDEN LINE (11%) to provide cross -border 
logistics services for temperature -controlled and general cargo across 
Thailand –China–ASEAN routes.RUIYUN INTERNATIONAL SUPPLY CHAIN (THAILAND) CO., LTD.

 Freight Business Expansion
SCGJWD Freight continued to expand its digital service offerings to 
enhance value, including the National Single Window (NSW) and Custom -X 
(platforms for customs clearance). The company also signed new service 
agreements with several key customers for electronic customs services
Overseas Business Expansion -Vietnam
SCGJWD Logistics (Vietnam) demonstrated strong growth momentum in 2025, 
signing multiple new contracts with major customers for end -to-end logistics 
services covering land and sea transportation, warehousing, and machinery 
installation. The company further strengthened its service capability through 
strategic collaboration with Transimex .
